items.title: Show HN: TypeGPU Realtime Physics Sandbox
items.contentSnippet:
Inspired by Konrad Reczko Depth-aware light injection in TypeGPU - the sandbox showcases realtime PBF fluid simulation, Eulerian smoke, and multi-source light simulation on photos, videos, and live webcam.
Scene gravity is inferred from the depth maps surface normals so tilted scenes should simulate fluid motion accurately.
It also includes a few fun features like hand tracking and a WIP cup interior detection so you can fill up cups/glasses that appear in live video.

items.title: Show HN: We built semantic search over the GTA 6 Extended Look
items.contentSnippet:
You can try it here: https://tracker.gg/gta6/trailers/netflix-extended-look/
We used SAM3 and Gemini Embedding 2 to capture a limited ontology over the latest GTA 6 preview. We've combined that with Gemini Embedding to allow users to search and find characters, vehicles, weapons and buildings that appeared in the preview.
Gemini Flash was also used to produce descriptions of each shot and each scene.
